title: Lion of Judah
lyrics_original: At the end of the age
And the eyes of all men
Will be fixed on the Lamb
Who was slain for the world!
As the King of all Kings,
And the Lord of all Lords!
There's a shield in our hand
And a sword at our side.
There's a fire in our spirits
And the ears of all men
Need to hear of the Lamb
Yet was raised up to reign
Who was slain for the world!
As the King of all Kings,
And the Lord of all Lords!
Who was slain for the world!
As the King of all Kings,
And the Lord of all Lords!

bible_verses.english: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome to open the book and its seven seals.”
saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been slain to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”
The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, You are the conquering Lion and the worthy Lamb who gave everything for my redemption. Thank You for reigning over all creation with wisdom, justice, and enduring mercy. Fix my eyes on You today so that I am not shaken by the troubles of this world. May my life glorify Your name as I look forward to the day You gather every nation before You. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Jesus holds the ultimate tension of divine majesty and humble sacrifice—He is both the roaring Lion of Judah and the sacrificed Lamb. Because He laid down His life and rose in victory, His reign is defined by perfect wisdom and boundless mercy. As we sing of His coming kingdom, our hearts are invited to surrender our worries to the King who rules with grace. May our eyes remain fixed on Him today, trusting in His eternal promise to make all things right.
